content.short: Starch Industries uses Cardano NFTs and the StarchChain sidechain to help democratize blockchain mining.
content.description: Starch Industries is an innovative blockchain project that simplifies the mining process through a unique NFT-based model. By owning 'Miner Token' NFTs, participants gain access to the StarchChain sidechain, which utilizes a Proof of Attendance (PoA) consensus mechanism. This approach rewards users for their presence and active participation in the ecosystem, eliminating the need for expensive hardware. The project features interactive digital assets that 'mine' $STRCH tokens, fostering a competitive and engaging environment that democratizes access to crypto rewards for all users.
